subject: IAM evidence request and SOC 2 status - HaloTech
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@halotech.com>, HaloTech Security Team <secops@halotech.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: IAM evidence request and SOC 2 status - HaloTech

Hi Alice / HaloTech SecOps team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about HaloTech's roadmap for pilot and your security requirements. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary from our discovery:
- Pilot scope: invoice-extraction and customer support summarization (prod traffic planned after sandbox).
- Primary compliance asks: current SOC 2 status, HIPAA implications for PHI, and GDPR data residency questions.
- IAM controls: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC (admin vs. user roles), audit logs for admin actions.

Requested items from your side:
1) Timeline for sharing your vendor security questionnaire / any preferred format.
2) SAML IdP metadata (or IdP URL) so we can prep SP config.
3) SCIM provisioning details: expected attribute mapping and whether you want automatic provisioning or invite-only.
4) Primary security contact for formal evidence exchange (you mentioned a security inbox during the call).

What we will share from Redwood:
- SOC 2 Type II letter and summary (attached).
- SAML / SCIM integration guide and sample metadata for your IdP.
- RBAC matrix and admin control descriptions.

Proposed next steps:
- Alice / SecOps: share vendor questionnaire and SAML metadata by EOD next week if possible.
- Redwood: technical integration call (Aditya + engineering) to exchange metadata and test provisioning. Suggested window: Tue/Wed next week.

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-letter.pdf (SOC 2 summary). I can upload the integration guides after a quick internal tech pass (Aditya will follow up).

If that all looks good, can you confirm the security contact email and preferred questionnaire format (Word/PDF/CSV)?

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@halotech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: HaloTech Security Team <secops@halotech.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IAM evidence request and SOC 2 status - HaloTech

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap.

A few quick notes from our side: 
- Security contact: secops@halotech.com (cc'd here). For procurement we use the standard vendor questionnaire (Word doc) — happy to take a HubSpot link if that's simpler.
- SOC 2: we'll need your current Type II report and any gap remediation plans. If you can share the SOC 2 letter and an executive summary, we'll route to our compliance reviewers.
- SAML / SCIM: we support SAML 2.0 (IdP: Okta) and SCIM v2 for provisioning. I can provide our Okta metadata.xml and attribute mapping by Monday EOD.
- RBAC: we expect the ability to define at least two roles (admin, user) and audit records for role changes. Do you have a published RBAC matrix?

Can you also confirm whether Redwood supports encryption of tokens at rest and a separate admin console account for our security admins?

I'll share our vendor questionnaire as an attachment to secops@redwood.com unless you'd prefer a secure upload link.

Best,
Alice
Alice Chen
Head of IT Operations
HaloTech
alice.chen@halotech.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: HaloTech Security Team <secops@halotech.com>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@halotech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IAM evidence request and SOC 2 status - HaloTech

Hi all — quick technical follow-up.

A few specifics for the IdP/SP exchange: 
- SP ACS (Assertion Consumer Service) URL: https://app.redwood.com/saml/acs
- SP EntityID: https://app.redwood.com/saml/metadata
- NameID format supported: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
- Attribute mapping (we expect): email -> mail, givenName -> givenName, familyName -> sn, groups -> groups

SCIM test details: 
- SCIM Base URL (test): https://api.staging.redwood.com/scim/v2
- Bearer token will be provided for the test account (send a secure contact + SSH key if you prefer key exchange).

RBAC / admin controls: 
- We provide an Org Admin role that can manage org-wide settings and invite users, and Workspace Admin roles limited to project-level configs.
- All admin actions emit audit events (admin.create, admin.update, role.assign) which are available in the Audit Log API (can be pushed to your SIEM).

If you want, we can create a short test plan and a sandbox account for your SecOps to run through SAML assertion and SCIM provisioning. Happy to stand up a 30-min tech session and walk through the metadata exchange.

- Aditya
Principal Software Engineer, Integrations
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@halotech.com>, HaloTech Security Team <secops@halotech.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IAM evidence request and SOC 2 status - HaloTech

Hi Alice / SecOps — attaching the initial artifacts to speed up your review. See the files and quick notes below.

Attachments:
- redwood-soc2-letter.pdf (SOC 2 Type II letter and executive summary)
- saml-metadata.xml (Redwood SP metadata stub)
- scim-provisioning-guide.pdf (attribute mappings and endpoints)
- rbac-matrix.xlsx (roles, permissions, and admin controls)

Notes: 
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II audit (report period Mar 2026–Mar 2027). The attached letter and exec summary are safe to share with your compliance team. If you need the full audit report we can initiate a non-disclosure flow (let me know preferred contact).
- SSO/SAML: Redwood supports SAML 2.0 as SP. The saml-metadata.xml contains the ACS URL and EntityID (use this to configure your Okta app). Aditya will be available for the metadata exchange and test sign-on.
- SCIM: We support SCIM v2 with optional automatic provisioning. The SCIM guide lists supported attributes (email, givenName, familyName, title, groups). If you have custom attributes, flag them and we can map.
- RBAC & admin controls: rbac-matrix.xlsx describes built-in roles (Org Admin, Workspace Admin, User) and what actions each can perform. All admin role changes are logged and retained per our retention policy.

Next steps: 
1) HaloTech: please send Okta metadata + vendor questionnaire (Word preferred).
2) Redwood: schedule technical session — Aditya, can you propose Tue/Wed windows for the metadata exchange?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call to walk the SecOps team through the attachments.

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
